subject: Quick demo request - Shiply onboarding
messages:
From: Abby Chen <abby@shiply.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request - Shiply onboarding

Hi Jordan,

We signed up via the self-serve flow this morning and are trying to validate Redwood for two main pieces of Shiply: an embeddings-based search for our driver docs and a low-latency chat endpoint for live ETA/exception answers in our tracking UI.

High-level:
- Avg daily calls: ~100k (mostly lookups + chat pre- and post-auth)
- Typical tokens: ~120 tokens/request (including prompt + context)
- Peak profile: we have short bursts tied to batch dispatch windows (roughly 300-400 QPS for 2-3 minutes)
- Timeline: aiming to pilot late April and production early May

Can we book a quick run-through/demo this week? Ideally we want to: 1) confirm latency/cost tradeoffs for embeddings+chat, 2) see sandbox access to run a small traffic sweep, and 3) cover compliance (SOC 2) requirements. I attached a short requirements sheet.

Thanks — Abby
Abby Chen
Head of Platform Integrations, Shiply Logistics
abby@shiply.ai
shiply.ai
Attachment: shiply-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Quick demo request - Shiply onboarding

Hi Abby — great to meet you (virtually) and congrats on getting through signup. I looped in Priyom (solutions eng) so we can scope the run-through and sandbox. A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the demo: 

1) Can you confirm peak sustained QPS (not just short bursts)? You mentioned 300-400 for batch windows; is that a recurring daily peak?
2) What % of traffic will be embeddings vs chat vs reranking? (ballpark OK)
3) Latency SLO target for chat responses (p50/p95)?
4) Any region constraints (US / EU / APAC) or data residency needs?
5) Is SOC 2 Type II evidence required before sandbox access, or is an NDA enough to start the sandbox?

Propose three 30-minute demo slots next week (PST):
- Tue 3/21 09:30-10:00
- Tue 3/21 13:30-14:00
- Wed 3/22 11:00-11:30

If you already have preferred times, tell us and we can adjust. I attached a short Redwood one-pager on pricing/capacity so you have context ahead of time.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: rdw-pricing-onepager.pdf

From: Abby Chen <abby@shiply.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request - Shiply onboarding

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick reply — answers inline: 
- Peak sustained QPS: we expect 120-150 sustained during peak batch periods, with bursts up to ~380 for 2-4 minute windows when multiple regions dispatch. So both numbers are relevant.
- Traffic mix: ~60% embeddings (search), ~30% chat, ~10% reranking/batch scoring.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms for chat, p95 < 500ms ideally (our front-end experience team is conservative).
- Region: prefer us-west or us-east; must remain in US for data residency.
- SOC 2: we require SOC 2 evidence before any managed account goes live; for sandbox/proof-of-concept an NDA + SOC 2 summary is usually sufficient.

We can do Tue 3/21 13:30 PST — that works for the integration team. Also attaching the requirement workbook with a little more detail.

One question: is Redwood able to provide a short-term sandbox with tokens/keys that limit cost and lifetime? We want to run a controlled sweep (10k requests) before the call to demonstrate patterns.

Cheers,
Abby
Attachment: shiply-requirements.xlsx

Hi Abby — Priyom from Redwood here, thanks for the details and the workbook. Confirming the 30-minute demo on Tue 21 Mar at 13:30 PST. I've created a short agenda and a demo sandbox plan so we can use your 10k sweep safely:

Agenda (30m):
- 0:00-5:00 intro & success criteria (Jordan)

- 15:00-25:00 chat latency & cost tradeoffs, quantization/throughput options (Priyom)
- 25:00-30:00 next steps, sandbox delivery, compliance notes (Jordan)

Ask before the demo: can you upload a small sample of your driver docs (~1-2k tokens total) and a CSV with a short traffic matrix (typical vs peak QPS) to the secure link below so we can pre-load the embeddings and avoid noisy cold-starts? If you prefer, we'll also prepare a traffic generator script and a time-limited API key (limits: 10k requests, expires in 7 days).
